answer: Propose a daily AI-trader permit spanning nectar and shale markets: each key irreversibly burns 2 credits; its combined rebates cap at 1 credit/day. Validators check key/day-bound burn receipts in a shared spent ledger; bad or reused receipts deny permits. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse burns. Ten keys burn 20 credits/day for at most 10 back.
